availableCommands.name: debug
availableCommands.description: Debug your current Claude Code session by reading the session debug log. (bundled)

availableCommands.name: audit
availableCommands.description: Comprehensive codebase audit for release readiness. Parallel exploration of docs, code, config, tests, and specs to identify cruft, then interactive triage with clear action options. (project)

availableCommands.name: codex
availableCommands.description: Use when the user asks to run Codex CLI (codex exec, codex resume) or wants Codex to review PRs, plans, or specs. Delegates to GPT-5.3-codex with preset reasoning modes. (project)

availableCommands.name: e2e
availableCommands.description: E2E testing patterns for kspec web UI. Use when writing Playwright tests, debugging hydration issues, or working with daemon fixtures. (project)

availableCommands.name: eval-agents
availableCommands.description: Evaluate whether AGENTS.md provides enough context for agents to make correct decisions. Spawns test agents with scenario questions and grades responses. (project)

availableCommands.name: local-review
availableCommands.description: Pre-PR quality review - verify AC coverage, test quality, E2E preference, and test isolation. (project)

availableCommands.name: pr
availableCommands.description: Create a pull request from current work. Handles branch creation, commits, push, and PR creation. Detects branch protection and guides through the PR workflow. (project)

availableCommands.name: pr-review
availableCommands.description: Review a PR linked to a kspec task, post findings as inline comments, and merge only when all quality gates pass. You NEVER fix code — you review and comment. If issues found, kick back to worker. (project)

availableCommands.name: release
availableCommands.description: Create versioned releases - bump version via PR, tag, create GitHub release. CI publishes to npm. (project)

availableCommands.name: svelte-5
availableCommands.description: Svelte 5 patterns, gotchas, and solutions. Use when working with Svelte 5/SvelteKit, especially for reactivity, SSR, and state management issues. (project)

availableCommands.name: create-workflow
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Formalize repeatable patterns into trackable kspec workflows. Design steps, choose triggers, create loop variants, and integrate with skills.

availableCommands.name: help
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Get help with kspec commands and workflows

availableCommands.name: observe
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Capture and act on systemic patterns — friction, successes, questions, and ideas. The feedback loop that drives process improvement.

availableCommands.name: plan
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Translate approved plans into specs and tasks. Import structured documents or create incrementally. Plans persist as durable artifacts with audit trail.

availableCommands.name: reflect
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Structured reflection at the end of work sessions. Identifies learnings, friction points, and improvements for system evolution.

availableCommands.name: review
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Kspec-specific review gates — spec alignment, own AC coverage, trait AC coverage, and validation integration. Building block for project-specific review workflows.

availableCommands.name: task-work
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Structured task lifecycle — start, work, note, submit, complete. Fix cycle handling, scope management, loop mode for automation, and quality gates.

availableCommands.name: triage
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Triage inbox items systematically. Records decisions with audit trail, then executes actions. Supports inbox, observations, and automation eligibility triage.

availableCommands.name: triage-automation
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Assess and prepare tasks for automation eligibility. Verify spec coverage, acceptance criteria, and task readiness for automated agents.

availableCommands.name: triage-inbox
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Process inbox items using the record-act pattern. Categorize, promote to spec/task, merge duplicates, defer, or delete stale items with full audit trail.

availableCommands.name: writing-specs
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Create and maintain specification items — modules, features, requirements, acceptance criteria, and traits. The source of truth for what to build.

availableCommands.description: Clear conversation history but keep a summary in context. Optional: /compact [instructions for summarization]

# UI/UX Revamp

## Specs

```yaml
- title: "UI Design System"
  slug: ui-design-system
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Port imgen's design token architecture into kspec's Tailwind-based web UI.
    Map oklch color tokens, spacing, radii, z-index, typography, and animation
    keyframes as Tailwind theme extensions. Establish consistent visual language
    across all views.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The web UI app.css file
      when: |
        imgen token-contract.css values are mapped as Tailwind @theme inline extensions
      then: |
        All 16 color tokens, 4 radii, 7 spacing, 7 z-index, and 3 font families
        are available as Tailwind utility classes (e.g. bg-design-surface, border-design-border)
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        A component using design tokens
      when: |
        The dark theme tokens are applied
      then: |
        oklch colors render correctly and status colors (pending=amber, in_progress=orange,
        pending_review=blue, needs_work=yellow, completed=emerald, blocked=red, cancelled=gray)
        are visually distinct
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        A view with loading states
      when: |
        Content is loading
      then: |
        Shimmer animation plays on skeleton elements, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        An active agent task card
      when: |
        The agent is working
      then: |
        Breathing/pulse animation plays on the card border, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion

- title: "App Shell and Navigation"
  slug: ui-app-shell
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Restructure the web UI layout with collapsible sidebar navigation, header bar
    with command palette and connection status, and grouped navigation sections.
    Preserve existing functionality during migration.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The web UI loaded in daemon mode
      when: |
        The app shell renders
      then: |
        A collapsible sidebar shows grouped navigation: Work (Dashboard, Tasks, Agents, Sessions),
        Specs (Specs, Plans, Validate), Capture (Inbox, Observations, Triage),
        Config (Workflows, Settings)
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        Sidebar navigation items
      when: |
        Items have actionable counts (inbox items, unresolved observations, pending review tasks)
      then: |
        Badge counts display next to the relevant nav items
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        The /items route
      when: |
        A user navigates to /items
      then: |
        They are redirected to /specs preserving any query parameters
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        The Observations nav item
      when: |
        There are zero unresolved observations
      then: |
        The nav item is still visible (not hidden)

- title: "Task Board (Kanban)"
  slug: ui-task-board
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Kanban-style task board with columns mapping to kspec task states.
    Active Fleet row shows currently running agent work with live output.
    Task cards show key metadata, clicking opens detail modal.
    Not drag-and-drop — tasks transition via agents/CLI.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        Tasks in various states
      when: |
        The task board renders
      then: |
        Tasks are distributed into columns: Backlog (pending, manual_only/unassessed),
        Ready (pending, eligible), In Progress (in_progress, needs_work),
        Review (pending_review), Done (completed recent), with blocked and cancelled
        handled as sections/indicators
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        A task card on the board
      when: |
        The card renders
      then: |
        It shows priority badge, tag chips, title, slug (mono), spec ref link,
        and metadata footer (notes count, dependency count, age)
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        A task card
      when: |
        The user clicks it
      then: |
        A detail modal opens showing full task info: title, description, status,
        priority, type, spec ref, tags, dependencies, blocked-by, notes, todos,
        automation status, VCS info (branch, PR link), plan ref, session link
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        Agents actively working on tasks (dispatch running)
      when: |
        The task board renders
      then: |
        An Active Fleet row appears at the top showing cards with task title,
        agent name, elapsed time with pulse indicator, and last few lines of output
    - id: ac-5
      given: |
        The task board with WebSocket connected
      when: |
        A task state changes
      then: |
        The board updates in real-time without page refresh
    - id: ac-6
      given: |
        The task detail modal in daemon mode
      when: |
        The user clicks action buttons (Start, Submit, Complete, Block, Add Note)

        The corresponding task transition or mutation is executed via API

<!--
  AC: @ui-task-board ac-3 — Task detail modal with full task info.
  AC: @ui-task-board ac-6 — Action buttons: Start, Submit, Complete, Block, Add Note.
-->
<script lang="ts">
	import type { TaskDetail } from '@kynetic-ai/shared';
	import { base } from '$app/paths';
	import {
		fetchTask,
		startTask,
		submitTask,
		completeTask,
		blockTask,
		addTaskNote
	} from '$lib/api';
	import { isStaticMode, ReadOnlyModeError } from '$lib/stores/mode.svelte';
	import * as Dialog from '$lib/components/ui/dialog';
	import { Badge } from '$lib/components/ui/badge';
	import { Button } from '$lib/components/ui/button';
	import { Textarea } from '$lib/components/ui/textarea';
	import { Input } from '$lib/components/ui/input';
	import { Separator } from '$lib/components/ui/separator';
	import { getStatusClasses, formatAge } from './board-utils';

	let {
		open = $bindable(false),
		taskRef = $bindable<string | null>(null),
		onTaskUpdated
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		taskRef?: string | null;
		onTaskUpdated?: () => void;
	} = $props();

	let task = $state<TaskDetail | null>(null);
	let loading = $state(false);
	let error = $state('');
	let actionError = $state('');
	let isSubmitting = $state(false);

	// Note form
	let noteContent = $state('');

	// Block/Complete reason form
	let reasonInput = $state('');
	let showReasonFor = $state<'block' | 'complete' | null>(null);

	$effect(() => {
		if (open && taskRef) {
			loadTask(taskRef);
		} else if (!open) {
			task = null;
			error = '';
			actionError = '';
			noteContent = '';
			reasonInput = '';
			showReasonFor = null;
		}
	});

	async function loadTask(ref: string) {
		loading = true;
		error = '';
		try {
			task = await fetchTask(ref);
		} catch (err) {
			error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load task';
		} finally {
			loading = false;
		}
	}

	async function reloadAndNotify() {
		if (task) {
			task = await fetchTask(task._ulid);
		}
		onTaskUpdated?.();
	}

	async function handleAction(action: () => Promise<void>) {
		isSubmitting = true;
		actionError = '';
		try {
			await action();
			await reloadAndNotify();
		} catch (err) {
			if (err instanceof ReadOnlyModeError) {
				actionError = err.message;
			} else {
				actionError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Action failed';
			}
		} finally {
			isSubmitting = false;
		}
	}

	function handleStart() {
		if (!task) return;
		handleAction(() => startTask(task!._ulid));
	}

Perfect! Now I have all the information needed. Let me compile the comprehensive report.

## Kspec Daemon API - Complete Exploration Report

I've thoroughly explored the kspec daemon API architecture. Here's the complete specification:

### 1. SESSION-RELATED API ENDPOINTS

**Location:** `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/routes/meta.ts`

```typescript
GET /api/meta/session
```
- Returns session context (focus, threads, questions)
- Response format:
```typescript
{
  focus: string | null,
  threads: Array<{ id: string; title: string; notes: string[] }> | null,
  questions: Array<{ id: string; text: string; answer?: string }> | null,
  updated_at: string (ISO 8601)
}
```

**Other Meta Endpoints:**
- `GET /api/meta/agents` - Returns array of agent definitions with id, name, adapter
- `GET /api/meta/workflows` - Returns array of workflow definitions
- `GET /api/meta/observations` - Returns observations with filter support (resolved status, type)

### 2. EVENTS.JSONL FORMAT & SESSION TYPES

**Location:** `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/src/sessions/types.ts`

**Session Status Enum:**
```typescript
type SessionStatus = "active" | "completed" | "abandoned" | "timed_out" | "failed"
```

**Session Trigger Types:**
```typescript
type SessionTrigger = 
  | "manual"
  | "task.in_progress"      // Task already being worked on
  | "task.ready"            // Task became ready
  | "task.needs_work"       // Fix cycle
  | "task.pending_review"   // PR review
  | "legacy"                // Old ralph sessions
```

**Session Metadata Structure:**
```typescript
{
  id: string                    // ULID
  task_id?: string
  agent_type: string
  agent_id?: string            // From agent definition
  trigger?: SessionTrigger      // Defaults to "legacy" for old sessions
  status: SessionStatus
  started_at: string (ISO 8601)
  ended_at?: string (ISO 8601) // Only when status != 'active'
  end_requested?: boolean
  end_reason?: string
  close_reason?: string
}
```

**Event Types Supported:**
```typescript
type EventType =
  | "session.start"
  | "session.update"
  | "iteration.timeout"
  | "session.end"
  | "session.wrapup"
  | "prompt.sent"
  | "tool.call"
  | "tool.result"
  | "note"
  | "agent.dispatched"
  | "agent.started"
  | "agent.completed"
  | "agent.failed"
  | "agent.timeout"
```

**Session Event Structure (in events.jsonl):**
```typescript
{
  ts: number                    // Unix timestamp milliseconds (auto-assigned)
  seq: number                   // 0-indexed sequence number (auto-assigned)
  type: EventType
  session_id: string
  trace_id?: string             // Optional correlation ID
  data: unknown                 // Type-specific payload
}
```

**Blob Externalization for Large Payloads:**
```typescript
interface SessionBlobPointer {
  path: string                  // e.g., "blobs/<file>"
  bytes: number                 // UTF-8 byte length
  sha256: string                // Content hash
  truncated: true               // Always true
  preview: string               // Bounded preview (512 bytes max)
}
```

- Fields externalized when >16KB: tool response stdout/stderr, large text chunks
- Entire data payload externalized if line exceeds 256KB
- Blobs stored in `.kspec/sessions/{id}/blobs/` directory

**Task Budget Structure:**
```typescript
{
  max_per_cycle: number         // Max tasks per cycle
  started_this_cycle: number    // Count in current cycle
}
```
Stored in `.kspec/sessions/{id}/budget.json` (LOCAL filesystem, not shadow branch)

### 3. WEBSOCKET EVENTS & STREAMING

**Location:** `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/websocket/`

**WebSocket Connection Flow:**

1. **Connect to:** `ws://localhost:3456/ws`
   - Query params: `?project=<path>` (required if no X-Kspec-Dir header)
   - Header: `X-Kspec-Dir: <path>` (alternative to query param)

2. **Connection Established Event:**
```typescript
{
  event: "connected",
  data: {
    session_id: string  // Unique session ID for this connection
  }
}
```

**WebSocket Commands (send as JSON):**

```typescript
// Subscribe to topics
{
  action: "subscribe",
  request_id?: string,
  payload: {
    topics: string[]  // e.g., ["agents", "tasks:updates"]
  }
}

// Unsubscribe from topics
{
  action: "unsubscribe",
  request_id?: string,
  payload: {
    topics: string[]
  }
}

// Ping (application-level)
{
  action: "ping",
  request_id?: string
}
```

**Acknowledgment Response:**
```typescript
{
  ack: true,
  request_id?: string,
  success: boolean,
  error?: string,
  details?: string
}
```

**Broadcast Event Format (received on subscribed topics):**
```typescript
{
  msg_id: string                // ULID
  seq: number                   // Per-connection sequence number
  timestamp: string (ISO 8601)
  topic: string
  event: string
  data: Record<string, unknown>
}
```

**Available Topics & Events:**

**Topic: `agents`**
```typescript
// Event: agent_invocation
{
  event: "agent_invocation",
  data: {
    session_id: string,
    agent_id: string,
    task_id: string | null,
    status: "dispatched" | "started" | "completed" | "failed" | "timed_out",
    timestamp: string (ISO 8601)
  }
}

// Event: agent_text_chunk (streaming output)
{
  event: "agent_text_chunk",
  data: {
    session_id: string,
    agent_id: string,
    task_id: string | null,
    text: string,              // Chunk of text or empty string (sentinel)
    timestamp: number (ms)
  }
}
```

**Topic: `tasks:updates`**
```typescript
// Event: task_updated
{
  event: "task_updated",
  data: {
    ref: string,               // Task reference (e.g., "@task-id")
    ulid: string,              // Task ULID
    action: "start" | "note_added" | "submit" | "complete" | "block",
    status?: string,           // New status if action changed it
    note_ulid?: string         // Populated for note_added action
  }
}
```

**Backpressure Handling:**
- Max buffered output: 1MB per connection
- Broadcast skipped if buffer exceeds threshold with warning log

### 4. TASK API ENDPOINTS

**Location:** `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/routes/tasks.ts`

```typescript
GET /api/tasks
```
- Query params: `status`, `type`, `tag` (each supports arrays), `limit`, `offset`
- Returns:
```typescript
{
  items: Array<{
    _ulid: string,
    slugs: string[],
    title: string,
    status: TaskStatus,
    priority?: number,
    spec_ref?: string,
    meta_ref?: string,
    tags?: string[],
    depends_on?: string[],
    notes_count: number,
    todos_count: number,
    automation?: string,
    started_at?: string,
    completed_at?: string,
    created_at: string
  }>,
  total: number,
  offset: number,
  limit: number
}
```

```typescript
GET /api/tasks/:ref
```
- Resolves task by reference (ULID or slug)
- Returns full task object with notes, todos, dependencies

```typescript
POST /api/tasks/:ref/start
```
- Transitions task to `in_progress`
- Returns updated task
- Broadcasts `task_updated` event with action `start`

```typescript
POST /api/tasks/:ref/note
```
- Body: `{ content: string }`
- Appends note to task
- Returns: `{ success: true, note, task }`
- Broadcasts `task_updated` event with action `note_added`

```typescript
POST /api/tasks/:ref/submit
```
- Transitions task to `pending_review` (from `in_progress` or `needs_work`)
- Broadcasts `task_updated` event with action `submit`

```typescript
POST /api/tasks/:ref/complete
```
- Body: `{ reason: string }`
- Transitions task to `completed` and sets `completed_at`
- Broadcasts `task_updated` event with action `complete`

```typescript
POST /api/tasks/:ref/block
```
- Body: `{ reason: string }`
- Transitions task to `blocked` and adds blocking note
- Broadcasts `task_updated` event with action `block`

### 5. AGENT DISPATCH API ENDPOINTS

**Location:** `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/routes/agent-dispatch.ts`

```typescript
POST /api/agent/dispatch
```
- Body: `{ action: "start" | "stop" }`
- Starts or stops the dispatch engine for a project

```typescript
GET /api/agent/status
```
- Returns public status:
```typescript
{
  dispatch_enabled: boolean,
  active_invocations: Array<{
    session_id: string,
    agent_id: string,
    task_ref: string | null,
    elapsed_ms: number
  }>,
  queue_depth: number,
  agent_definitions: Array<{
    id: string,
    name: string,
    adapter: string  // e.g., "claude-agent-acp"
  }>
}
```

```typescript
GET /api/agent/dispatch/status
```
- Returns internal engine status (raw format)

```typescript
POST /api/agent/events
POST /api/agent/event (legacy alias)
```
- Body:
```typescript
{
  task_id: string,
  task_ref?: string,
  from_status: TaskStatus,
  to_status: TaskStatus,
  timestamp?: number
}
```
- Posted by CLI when task state changes
- Broadcast triggers agent dispatch logic

### 6. SESSION DATA STORAGE STRUCTURE

**File Structure:**
```
.kspec/sessions/{session-id}/
  session.yaml          # Metadata (YAML)
  events.jsonl          # Append-only event log (one JSON object per line)
  budget.json           # Task budget state (LOCAL only)
  context-iter-{n}.json # Context snapshots per iteration
  blobs/                # Externalized payloads
    000000-<field>-<uuid>.blob
```

**Key Storage Functions (src/sessions/store.ts):**
- `createSession()` - Create new session with metadata
- `getSession()` - Read session metadata
- `updateSessionStatus()` - Update status and ended_at
- `listSessions()` - List all session IDs
- `appendEvent()` - Atomically append event to events.jsonl
- `closeSession()` - Close session with status and reason
- `requestEndLoop()` - Signal end-loop request
- `isEndLoopRequested()` - Check if end-loop requested
- `readEvents()` - Read events from session
- `readEventsSince()` - Get events after a sequence number
- `compactSessionEvents()` - Compact event log
- `searchSessionEvents()` - Search events by pattern

**Auto-assignment in appendEvent:**
- `ts`: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) - auto-assigned if not provided
- `seq`: 0-indexed sequence number - auto-assigned by reading last event

### 7. HEALTH CHECK & OTHER ENDPOINTS

```typescript
GET /api/health
```
- Returns:
```typescript
{
  status: "ok",
  uptime: number (seconds),
  connections: number,
  version: string
}
```

**Default Daemon Port:** `3456`

**Localhost-Only Security:**
- Rejects non-localhost connections with 403 Forbidden
- Accepts: `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `::1`

### 8. KEY IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS

**WebSocket Security & Binding:**
- Per-connection project binding via `X-Kspec-Dir` header or `?project=` query param
- All broadcasts filtered by project path to prevent cross-project data leaks
- Session ID generated per WebSocket connection (not persistent)

**Event Persistence:**
- Atomic appends for crash safety
- Oversized fields (>16KB) externalized to blob files automatically
- Entire data externalized if line would exceed 256KB
- Full blob content available via `resolveSessionBlobPointers()`

**Text Chunk Streaming:**
- Agent text output streamed in chunks via `agent_text_chunk` events
- Empty string chunks act as message boundary sentinels (non-text updates)
- Callback: `onTextChunk(sessionId, agentId, taskId, text)` in dispatch engine

**Event Sources:**
1. **Agent Runtime** - Session events appended by invocation lifecycle
2. **Dispatch Engine** - Invocation events and text chunks
3. **REST API** - State change events from CLI and web UI

---

**File Paths (Absolute):**
- `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/src/sessions/types.ts` - Session and event schemas
- `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/src/sessions/store.ts` - Event storage implementation
- `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/routes/meta.ts` - Session API endpoint
- `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/routes/tasks.ts` - Task API endpoints
- `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/routes/agent-dispatch.ts` - Agent dispatch API
- `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/websocket/types.ts` - WebSocket protocol types
- `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/websocket/handler.ts` - WebSocket message handling
- `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/websocket/pubsub.ts` - Pub/sub broadcast system
- `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui/packages/daemon/src/server.ts` - Server setup and middleware

<script lang="ts">
	import { page } from '$app/stores';
	import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
	import type { TaskSummary, BroadcastEvent } from '@kynetic-ai/shared';
	import { fetchTasks, fetchAgentStatus, type AgentStatus } from '$lib/api';
	import { subscribe, unsubscribe, on, off } from '$lib/stores/connection.svelte';
	import { getProjectVersion } from '$lib/stores/project.svelte';
	import { distributeToColumns, type BoardColumn } from '$lib/components/board/board-utils';
	import BoardColumnComponent from '$lib/components/board/BoardColumn.svelte';
	import ActiveFleetRow from '$lib/components/board/ActiveFleetRow.svelte';
	import TaskDetailModal from '$lib/components/board/TaskDetailModal.svelte';
	import BoardSkeleton from '$lib/components/board/BoardSkeleton.svelte';
	import LayoutGrid from '@lucide/svelte/icons/layout-grid';
	import List from '@lucide/svelte/icons/list';
	import { Button } from '$lib/components/ui/button';
	import { base } from '$app/paths';

	let tasks = $state<TaskSummary[]>([]);
	let columns = $state<BoardColumn[]>([]);
	let loading = $state(true);
	let error = $state('');
	let agentStatus = $state<AgentStatus | null>(null);

	// Detail modal state
	let modalOpen = $state(false);
	let selectedTaskRef = $state<string | null>(null);

	// Track last processed URL ref to avoid infinite loops
	let lastProcessedRef = $state('');

	$effect(() => {
		// Re-derive columns whenever tasks change
		columns = distributeToColumns(tasks);
	});

	// AC: @ui-task-board ac-5 — Reload on project change
	$effect(() => {
		const version = getProjectVersion();
		if (version > 0) {
			loadBoard();
		}
	});

	// Open task detail from URL param
	$effect(() => {
		const urlRef = $page.url.searchParams.get('ref');
		if (urlRef && urlRef !== lastProcessedRef) {
			lastProcessedRef = urlRef;
			selectedTaskRef = urlRef;
			modalOpen = true;
		}
	});

	async function loadBoard() {
		loading = true;
		error = '';
		try {
			const [taskResponse, statusResponse] = await Promise.all([
				fetchTasks({ limit: 500 }),
				fetchAgentStatus().catch(() => null)
			]);
			tasks = taskResponse.items;
			agentStatus = statusResponse;
		} catch (err) {
			error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load board';
		} finally {
			loading = false;
		}
	}

	function handleCardClick(task: TaskSummary) {
		selectedTaskRef = task._ulid;
		modalOpen = true;
	}

	function handleTaskUpdated() {
		loadBoard();
	}

	// AC: @ui-task-board ac-5 — WebSocket real-time updates
	function handleTaskUpdate(event: BroadcastEvent) {
		loadBoard();
	}

	// AC: @ui-task-board ac-4 — Refresh agent status on agent events
	function handleAgentUpdate(event: BroadcastEvent) {
		fetchAgentStatus()
			.then((status) => {
				agentStatus = status;
			})
			.catch(() => {});
	}

		"test:e2e": "npm run build && playwright test",
		"test:e2e:ui": "npm run build && playwright test --ui",
		"test:e2e:headed": "npm run build && playwright test --headed"

	"dependencies": {
		"@kynetic-ai/shared": "*",

		"autoprefixer": "^10.4.23",
		"bits-ui": "^2.15.4",
		"clsx": "^2.1.1",

		"typescript": "^5.9.3",
		"vite": "^7.2.6"
	}
}

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(web-ui): implement session stream view

Add the session stream view for watching agent work — both historical and
live sessions. Renders structured session events from events.jsonl as
blocks: agent messages (markdown), tool calls (collapsible with icon,
input/output, timing), and thinking blocks (collapsed by default).

Key changes:
- Daemon API: New /api/sessions endpoints (list, get, get events)
  with session ID prefix resolution and incremental loading via since_seq
- Session stream components: MessageBlock, ToolCallView, ThinkingBlock,
  SystemBlock, SessionStream with auto-scroll, SessionContextPanel
- Live streaming: WebSocket agent_text_chunk events with periodic
  structured refresh (3s interval for active sessions)
- Auto-scroll: 100px threshold, debounced user scroll detection,
  jump-to-bottom button
- Context panel: Session metadata, stats, timeline, trigger info
- Sessions list: Updated from placeholder to full session history

All animations gated behind prefers-reduced-motion. Status colors use
design system tokens. Loading skeleton, error, and empty states included.

Task: @implement-session-stream-view
Spec: @ui-session-stream

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
